description: Offshore Oil Leases is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California State Lands Commission. The polygons in this layer show the position of Offshore Oil Leases as documented by former State Lands Senior Boundary Determination Officer, Cris N. Perez and as reviewed and updated by GIS and Boundary staff. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher California State Lands Commission. Its tags are CSLC, California State Lands Commission, Leases, MRMD, Offshore Oil Leases. It offers 11 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GDB, GEOJSON, GPKG. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
